classification_detail: Closer hop 3 proved the direct tangent inequality log |x| ≤ m|x| - log m - 1, routing around normalized-measure Jensen. The remaining sorry is confined to the finite-negative-part EReal interface: package the custom negative part as AEMeasurable, deduce f ≠ 0 a.e. on E from its finite lintegral, and identify the EReal difference with the ordinary log integral before applying setIntegral_mono_ae.
